title: Direct powers, ultrapowers and cumulative powers
summary: In this paper we investigate cumulative direct powers of functions on structures, or cumulative powers, and study their properties. Particularly, we show how they extend the preservation phenomena of reduced powers, direct powers and ultrapowers by offering a characterization of the fragment of first-order theory it preserves, and elucidate the connections between the three sorts of constructions.
